events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

I’ll build this as a self-contained canvas scene: procedural bowl, broth, toppings, steam, glow, and mouse parallax all rendered inline, with a reduced-motion path that keeps the composition calm and accessible.
The page is in place. I’m doing a quick sanity check now for JavaScript syntax and the single-file constraint, then I’ll hand it over.

input.command: /bin/zsh -lc "node --check <(sed -n '/<script>/,/<\\/script>/p' index.html | sed '1d;"'$d'"') && rg -n \"https?://|<link|<img|<video|<audio|url\\(\" index.html || true && git diff --stat && git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const s=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8').match(/<script>([\\\\s\\\\S]*)<\\\\/script>/)[1]; new Function(s); console.log('JavaScript syntax: OK')\"; if rg -n 'https?://|<link|<img|<video|<audio|url\\\\(' index.html; then exit 1; else echo 'External asset references: none'; fi; wc -c index.html"

/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const s=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8').match(/<script>([\\\\s\\\\S]*)<\\\\/script>/)[1]; new Function(s); console.log('JavaScript syntax: OK')\"; rg -n -e 'https?://' -e '<link' -e '<img' -e '<video' -e '<audio' -e 'url\\(' index.html || true; wc -c index.html"

events.content:
Created [index.html](<WORKSPACE>/openai/gpt-5.6-luna/medium/index.html).

It includes:

- Fully inline CSS and JavaScript
- Procedural canvas-rendered vegan ramen bowl
- Animated steam, broth shimmer, floating motes, and warmth
- Mouse-responsive parallax
- Responsive sizing
- `prefers-reduced-motion` support
- Zero external assets or dependencies
- No UI, text, or menus

excluded: large base64 and embedded image data (event retained with size marker)
